title: Main Event Bill, Season Documentary, Media Day: developed and combined
question: Each of the three developed on its own, then four combinations. Copy follows your notes: the wordmark wherever BrickBot appears, the motto, one plain line that we qualified for the FIRST Championship 2026, no boasting. Pick one, or use Steer to mix parts.

options.label: Main Event Bill, developed
options.thesis: The motto as the headline act: BrickBot presents "We build our future / BRICK BY BRICK" in towering condensed type, a yellow duotone of the Nationals crowd full height on the right, one burgundy billing line: Qualified · FIRST Championship 2026.
options.viewport: The motto as the headline act: BrickBot presents "We build our future / BRICK BY BRICK" in towering condensed type, a yellow duotone of the Nationals crowd full height on the right, one burgundy billing line: Qualified · FIRST Championship 2026.
options.risk: Poster type at this scale needs a strong condensed face that also has Romanian diacritics.

options.label: Season Documentary, developed
options.thesis: A series title card: "A season with" over the wordmark across a full-bleed, darkened photo; the motto and one plain line below; a chapter strip runs through the season (Nationals, FIRST Championship, Twin Cup, BioBuzz now).
options.viewport: A series title card: "A season with" over the wordmark across a full-bleed, darkened photo; the motto and one plain line below; a chapter strip runs through the season (Nationals, FIRST Championship, Twin Cup, BioBuzz now).
options.risk: Rests on the photos; the chapter strip must link somewhere real (season page, posts).

options.label: Media Day, developed
options.thesis: A brand-yellow seamless sweep with a floor falloff; the black wordmark, the motto, a plain line and two actions; three big prints of the students casting soft floor shadows.
options.viewport: A brand-yellow seamless sweep with a floor falloff; the black wordmark, the motto, a plain line and two actions; three big prints of the students casting soft floor shadows.
options.risk: A yellow-drenched hero on a dark-first brand; dark sections follow. Best with a real media-day shoot.

options.label: Documentary × Bill
options.thesis: Full-bleed documentary photo, the motto set as a towering poster across it (white then yellow), a burgundy billing line, and the chapter strip.
options.viewport: Full-bleed documentary photo, the motto set as a towering poster across it (white then yellow), a burgundy billing line, and the chapter strip.
options.risk: Big type over a busy photo needs the darkening to hold contrast at every width.

options.label: Media Day × Bill
options.thesis: "BRICK BY BRICK" in giant black type on the yellow sweep, with student prints standing in front of the letters for real depth; the wordmark presents "We build our future".
options.viewport: "BRICK BY BRICK" in giant black type on the yellow sweep, with student prints standing in front of the letters for real depth; the wordmark presents "We build our future".
options.risk: The prints must never hide enough letters to break the motto.

options.label: Documentary × Media Day
options.thesis: The title card over the full-bleed photo on top, falling onto a yellow sweep below where the motto sits and student prints stand on the floor.
options.viewport: The title card over the full-bleed photo on top, falling onto a yellow sweep below where the motto sits and student prints stand on the floor.
options.risk: Two grounds in one screen; the seam between them must feel like a stage edge, not a section break.

options.label: All three
options.thesis: A slanted yellow sweep panel carries the wordmark and the towering motto; the documentary photo fills the rest with "A season with BrickBot" and "Qualified for the FIRST Championship 2026" as its title card and chapter strip.
options.viewport: A slanted yellow sweep panel carries the wordmark and the towering motto; the documentary photo fills the rest with "A season with BrickBot" and "Qualified for the FIRST Championship 2026" as its title card and chapter strip.
options.risk: The densest option; on phones the panel stacks above the photo.
